displayName: loop-sessions: the server scrubbed 10 or more credentials the agents missed in an hour

conditions.displayName: server-side scrub catches above 9 in an hour

documentation.content:
Ten or more times in an hour the server's scrub pass removed a credential a laptop's did not. Every client scrubs before upload with the same pattern set the server has; a catch on the server means a laptop is running a build whose patterns are behind, or a new credential shape the client set lacks.

`gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="loop-sessions" AND jsonPayload.message="ingest scrubbed a credential the agent missed"' --freshness=1h --format='value(jsonPayload.email,jsonPayload.device_id,jsonPayload.kinds,jsonPayload.event_type)'`. If the devices are on an old `agent_version` (their rows on /admin/fleet), it is version lag: `loop-sessions daemon --upgrade-now` on the machine. If they are on the published build, the kind is new to the client set: add the pattern to internal/scrub and publish a release (README 7b).

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-upgrade
